SimpleProduct:14863.name: Colouring Pencil Tins
SimpleProduct:14863.meta_title: Personalised Colouring Pencils | Name pencils for kids or teachers
SimpleProduct:14863.meta_description: Encourage your budding artist with our personalised colouring pencils, complete with a design and your child's name. Shop online for your pencil set today!
SimpleProduct:14863.faq:
What colour are the pencils?

Made with quality pigment, these colouring pencils transfer colour to paper smoothly and evenly. The 10 colours included in this kit are: Purple, Brown, Dark Blue, Blue, Dark Green, Green, Red, Pink, Orange & Yellow.

What size is the pencil tin?

The pencil tin measures 18cm wide x 10cm high (7" x 3.9") enough for 12 pencils!

description.html:
For the child who loves to draw or make their own art creations, this set of personalised colouring pencils makes a great gift for birthdays, holidays, or the start of the school year. Customise them for your child's teacher as a way to show your appreciation for all they do.

Made with quality pigment, these colouring pencils transfer colour to paper smoothly and evenly. The 10 colours included in this kit are: Purple, Brown, Dark Blue, Blue, Dark Green, Green, Red, Pink, Orange & Yellow.

Each set comes in a tin case that can be personalised with your child's name in your choice of colour and font.

Make this gift truly special by pairing it with our range of Activity Books, Sketchpads, or other Stationery supplies.

Pencil Tin size: 18cm wide x 10cm high (7" x 3.9").

Please Note: Whatever you type in the personalisation fields will be what is printed, so please make sure to double check your spelling.

short_description_right.html:
• 10 Personalised Colouring Pencils
  • Vibrant colours and quality pigment
  • Perfect for home and school use
  • Packaged in a convenient, personalised tin case
  • Tin: 18cm W x 10cm H (7" x 3.9")

short_description.html:
Stimulate creativity and artistic expression with this custom set of 10 Colouring Pencils that are the perfect starting set for young children. Whether your child is just starting out or is an experienced artist, these pencils make a great gift for drawing.

These Colouring Pencil Tins comes with your child's name on each pencil as well as a personalised tin design, which will help them from getting lost or mixed up with classmates' supplies at school.

Bright Star Kids is famous for making the cutest and longest lasting kids’ Name Labels & personalised School Supplies. Our name labels are waterproof, dishwasher friendly & our clothing name labels are safe to use in your washing machine & clothes dryer.

Your kids will love choosing their favourite colour, design & font for their name labels & matching school supplies. There are literally 100s of cute combos to personalise. You’ll love that there’s a name label for every single thing, so you never have to replace another item lost at school or daycare.

Since 2005, Bright Star Kids has been printing quality waterproof name labels & durable personalised school supplies that families love. With 7400+ reviews on our name labels alone, we know you’ll love using our name labels to help your kids keep track of their stuff.

Our School Labels Kit is a fan favourite for families looking for kids name labels because it includes 200 name labels that can be used to label every little thing from shoes to containers, drink bottles, clothes, hats, lunch boxes & more. The School Name Labels Kit is a game changer.

Our matching range of personalised school supplies includes: School Backpacks, Lunch Bags, Drink Bottles, Bag Tags, Pencil Cases & Name Labels.
